Thank you. It’s confusing to me as I’ve said the above to so many other people, taking my own advice seems more difficult. As I’ve been feeling pretty awful for a while and just plastering on a smile and getting on with it, it almost feels wrong not to be at work.

I’ve been given medication and a couple of weeks off for it to kick in. I’m scared of how my employer will react when I go back, but not as scared as I was of how self destructive I was being beforehand.

I was signed off work on Thursday with depression, anxiety and panic attacks. I didn’t even know that was what was wrong with me until I saw her. I thought I was useless, not embracing change and not managing my emotions effectively. I’d been telling myself the above for too long

I’m very fortunate in that I am employed, have a comfortable home and loving friends, family and partner. Shortly before the election I was diagnosed with depression, a combination of things made the world feel overwhelming, and I was anxious and crying for most of everyday.

I’m very fortunate in that I am employed, have a comfortable home and loving friends, family and partner. Shortly before the election I was diagnosed with depression, a combination of things made the world feel overwhelming, and I was anxious and crying for most of everyday.

I always think that anything creative shows the depression and anxiety who is boss, it may be a part of me, but it couldn’t exist without me. Whereas I could quite happily exist without it (if only that were an option!) the creativity shows I continue to be. 💕

Focus is a big problem for me too, knitting has a nice repetitive nature that helps when I’m anxious and is especially good for doctors waiting rooms. Although be prepared for people to ask what you’re making, I tend to just say a mess!
It could be both, even if you are depressed you’re feeding yourself, washing and indulging in some self care time. It sounds like a good combination to me 😊

As someone living with anxiety I am far more anxious about the idea of infecting someone else than I am about wearing the mask. My dad has COPD and wears a mask too. I’m slightly confused by the rules which seem to say both of us could choose not to.

I did find myself getting anxious the first couple of times out feeling the hot breath trapped around my face, used it as a reason to focus on extending my breath through my nose for the entirety of the journey and arrived feeling far less anxious than I usually would have 😊
